date_note: Sisa Journal, published 24 Nov, says the Financial Services Commission decided at its regular meeting the day before.
title: Korea fines Lotte Card over bond disclosure of data-leak risk
summary: Sisa Journal reports that South Korea's Financial Services Commission fined Lotte Card under the capital markets law for not adequately telling investors of the risk of a customer-data leak when it issued corporate bonds. Lotte Card says the leak was not yet confirmed at the time of disclosure, accepts the decision and will review its disclosure checks.
plain: Korean regulators fined Lotte Card, saying it did not adequately tell bond investors about a data-leak risk. The company accepts the decision.
exec: A regulator fined a card issuer over incomplete disclosure of data-leak risk to bond investors.

validation.note: Only Sisa Journal was read; the Financial Services Commission's own release was not read.
